title: Actaira surface difference, v1
description: Which capability appears, disappears, widens, narrows or changes between two surfaces. Five lists that are never mixed, plus a sixth for what could not be resolved on either side, which is counted apart and never distributed among the five. Nothing here is a total, an ordering or a summary.

added.description: A capability the second side has and the first did not.

removed.description: A capability the first side had and the second does not.

widened.description: A capability both sides have, where every difference between them is one this tool has a documented order for and they all point the same way. Absent an order, the entry is `changed` with both digests.

narrowed.description: The same, pointing the other way.

changed.description: A capability both sides have that is not the same on both, and whose difference no documented order covers. Both digests are published so a reader can decide for themselves.

indeterminate.description: A change either side of which could not be resolved, with the cause named, plus anything the second side could not resolve that the first could. Never counted with the five above.

unchanged.description: How many capabilities are byte-identical on both sides. A count of what did not move, never a proportion of anything.

not_read.description: Files on the second side that this release does not read. Named rather than skipped.

merge_rules.description: The documented merge rules the second side's capabilities cite, each with its URL, page digest and consultation date.

label.description: The ref or the directory as the operator named it.

kind.description: git-ref: materialised from `git ls-tree` and `git cat-file`, with no checkout. directory: read where it is.

tree_sha256.description: For a git ref, a digest over the whole recursive listing: mode, type, object id and path of every entry. Identifies the tree without a third git subcommand.

source.description: The file both sides of this pairing came from, relative to the root.

before.description: Null when the capability is new.

after.description: Null when the capability is gone.

digest.description: sha256 over the canonical bytes of the whole capability on this side. What an approval binds to, and what makes two runs comparable.

findings.description: The rules that fired on this capability on this side. Each names its rule, version, author and pack; the severity is that author's label and is never combined with another.
